values.en: A straight line has curvature identically zero. A line through $(x_0,y_0,z_0)$ with unit direction $(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ is parametrized by arc length as $\alpha(s)=(x_0+a_1s,\,y_0+a_2s,\,z_0+a_3s)$; since $\alpha$ is affine in $s$, $\alpha''(s)\equiv 0$, hence $\kappa=|\alpha''(s)|\equiv 0$.
values.zh-CN: 直线的曲率恒为零。过 $(x_0,y_0,z_0)$、以单位向量 $(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ 为方向的直线，以弧长 $s$ 参数化为 $\alpha(s)=(x_0+a_1s,\,y_0+a_2s,\,z_0+a_3s)$；由于 $\alpha$ 关于 $s$ 是仿射的，$\alpha''(s)\equiv 0$，故 $\kappa=|\alpha''(s)|\equiv 0$。
